messages:
maria: Heads up — we got a 28% cost bump on GPU bill this month vs projection. Our larger note: several commitments expire in ~30 days for us-west1/us-west2. Need a quick decision on whether to renew existing reservations, convert, or shift to savings plans. Any objections to doing a 14-day usage capture? 

kevin: :eyes: I'm seeing higher burst traffic for fine-tuning jobs last 2 weeks. We may be able to shave 10-15% by tighter job queueing and early termination. But that won't cover the full delta.

chris: Quick numbers from last 30d: total GPU hours = 45k, reserved-covered = 28k (62%), convertible-RI matched = 18k, spot = 6k. Effective utilization for reserved pool is 72% (reserved hours used / reserved hours purchased). If we renew as-is we waste ~28% of committed spend.

lisa: Can you reframe that as $ impact? Finance needs amortized monthly savings vs on-demand and the penalty if we overshoot commitments. Also report which SKUs (p4d/p3/rtx) are the worst offenders. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

chris: Rough ballpark: current monthly committed spend ~ $420k. With 72% util that's ~ $118k wasted commitment per month (vs flexible pay-for-use). But converting some reserved into compute savings plans could reduce waste by letting us shift across instance families; conversion won't help cross-region constraints. Worst SKUs: p4d in us-west2 (60% of waste), a few legacy p3s in eu-west1.

devops-bot: Billing export uploaded: gs://redwood-billing/exports/2026-02/gpu_usage_2026-02.parquet

maria: Thanks. Chris — can you run a short query to break down utilization by region/instance family and add tags for team ownership? We need to know what is safe to convert vs what must stay pinned regionally.

chris: On it. Here's the query I'm running in BigQuery (we'll share results):
```
SELECT region, instance_family, SUM(used_hours) used, SUM(reserved_hours) reserved,
ROUND(SUM(used_hours)/NULLIF(SUM(reserved_hours),0),2) util
FROM `billing.gpu_usage_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-02'
GROUP BY region, instance_family
ORDER BY util DESC;
```

kevin: Two operational notes: 1) For jobs that require local-attached NVLink (p4d), region pinning is mandatory; convertible RIs can't move across AZs but can convert to different sizes in same region. 2) Savings Plans (compute) give more flexibility across families and AZs but are less granular for instance-type-specific discounts.

lisa: If Savings Plan gives flexibility, why not move the whole commit to a 1-year compute plan and then rightsize instances? We can do top-level commit and apply rightsizing later during the term. What's downside?

chris: Downsides: 1) Savings Plans are amortized but lock cash and still assume baseline throughput — if our sustained baseline drops we still pay. 2) For some regulated workloads in eu-west1 we must keep dedicated reservations due to compliance/network egress constraints. That ~15% of committed spend can't be in a global savings plan.

maria: Actionable path proposal: A) Run 14-day capture for detailed utilization by team/sku (owner: chris). B) Short-term: for upcoming renewal window, convert ~40% of expiring reservations in us-west2 to 1-yr convertible RIs for p4d to keep latency-sensitive throughput while we complete capture (owner: kevin). C) Move remaining flexible compute demand to 1-yr Savings Plans capped at 50% of baseline (owner: lisa & finance-ops-bot). D) Start cross-team tagging cleanup to reduce untagged workloads (owner: chris). Deadline: final recommendation in 18 days (so we can submit purchase before expiry. )

kevin: I can take the p4d conversion workflow. I'll also run a test for spot-preemption pattern to reclaim ~5% if we tolerate retries.

finance-ops-bot: Noted — please add estimated monthly cash commitment deltas to the recommendation. We'll need PO routing if top line commitment > $300k/month.

maria: Also, please prepare a short explainer slide (1 page) for execs showing 3 scenarios: renew-as-is, mixed convertible+SP, aggressive rightsizing+lower commit. We'll present next Tuesday.

chris: I'll post the 14-day export into this thread by EOD tomorrow. Initial snapshot attached will include region/sku/team columns and a column 'can_convert' based on tags.

lisa: :thumbsup: Sounds good. If anyone sees a short-term capacity risk from conversions ping me immediately.

kevin: FYI — spot capacity in us-west2 is plentiful this week; we can queue low-priority experiments there.

maria: Great. Owners: chris (capture + report), kevin (convert test + ops runbook), lisa (finance delta + exec slide). We'll reconvene in 10 days in #eng-infra. Thanks.

devops-bot: Reminder: reservation expirations list updated: https://console.aws.amazon.com/ec2/v2/home?region=us-west-2#Reservations:filter=expiring;expiresBefore=2026-04-10

maria: End of thread — setting a calendar reminder. :calendar:
